title: Command palette
brief: Command palette over the bolt-v2 shell: requests, generic commands (Toggle theme, Show History, Show Environments, Open MCP approvals, New request, ...) with keybindings, variables with masked secrets, grouping, the empty query and the no-match state.

artboards.title: One grouped list
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest path and identical to bolt-v2/09; with 186 items the generic commands get buried under requests unless the user knows the > prefix

artboards.title: Scope tabs
artboards.tradeoff: Scopes are visible and the full command list is browsable with keybindings, unavailable commands explain why; one more row and one more key (Tab) before typing

artboards.title: List with preview
artboards.tradeoff: Shows the resolved URL, last status, keybinding or per-environment state before acting; the palette is 900 px wide and covers most of the document, and fewer rows fit
